name: PT Indonesia Kendaraan Terminal Tbk
summary: PT Indonesia Kendaraan Terminal Tbk engages in the cargo loading-unloading and stacking yard business activities in Malaysia. The company offers water transportation for passengers, animals, and goods; mooring, towing, and pilotage; and sea toll and port cleaning services. It is involved in the operation of terminal facilities, such as ports and docks, navigation, inspection of cargo and containers; and shipping and berthing activities; land, buildings, water, and electricity business services.
